chunks: We made several highways one over the other above you. We are not neglectful of creation.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'seven paths' above us?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'seven paths' (ṭarāʾiq) are often interpreted not merely as physical heavens but as distinct layers of spiritual reality and divine attributes through which creation is sustained. This verse underscores Allah’s omniscience by linking the complexity of the cosmic structure to His attentive awareness of every detail of His creation, reinforcing the concept of divine proximity and care.
